theme.label: Colour theme
theme.note: Six palettes from the zones of Save the World.

language.label: Language

dialog.title: What language do you want to use?

notes.1: This notification will not showing after selection.
notes.2: You can change this selection on the Settings page.

language.note: Menus and labels. Game data stays in English.

path.label: Game folder
path.note: The folder with FortniteLauncher.exe, usually FortniteGame\Binaries\Win64.
path.invalid: That folder does not contain FortniteLauncher.exe.

user-agent.label: User agent
user-agent.note: Used only when Fortnite is not installed.

custom-process.label: Game process
custom-process.note: The executable Penny watches to tell the game is running.

mission-interval.label: Mission check interval
mission-interval.note1: How often automation checks whether you are in a mission.

tray.label: Hide to system tray
tray.note: Closing the window keeps Penny running in the tray.

discord-rpc.label: Discord Rich Presence
discord-rpc.note: Shows In launcher, In Save the World or In Battle Royale on your profile.

enabled.label: Quest overlay
enabled.note: Your squad's quests on top of the game. Show or hide it with

custom-menu.title: Customizable menu
custom-menu.description: Choose what the sidebar shows. Hidden pages stay reachable from search (Ctrl+K) and from Customize at the foot of the rail.

account-customization.title: Account customization
account-customization.description: Give an account a nickname and drag to reorder the list.
account-customization.note: Nicknames only show in Penny; your Epic display name does not change.
